'''Search and Rescue Squad 204''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] squad posted on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] and commanded by [[Elara Dorne]]. Members of the squad included [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Tabber (Republic Army)|Tabber]], [[Ensign/Legends|Ensign]] [[Vise]], [[Ensign/Legends|Ensign]] [[Marko (ensign)|Marko]], [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Goran (corporal)|Goran]] and [[Ensign/Legends|Ensign]] [[Cav (ensign)|Cav]]. Elara Dorne led the squad to rescue [[Ensign/Legends|Ensign]] [[Tane]] and other captive Republic soldiers from the [[Fallenspire Stronghold]].
